comment: Dynamic-builder suggestion rules (phase 4). transitions: for each scale degree you are ON (1-7), the ranked scale degrees to go TO next - mode-agnostic, mapped through each mode's own diatonic numerals at suggestion time. colours: per family and destination degree, the tasteful-colour variants offered at spice 2 (slash basses only appear in the major table because bass digits read against the tonic's MAJOR scale). borrowed: the spice-3 pool per family, filtered per mode so anything already diatonic drops out. Every numeral here must parse and realise; tools/validate.js checks that.
